days_to_first_harvest.title: Kerala Agricultural University, crop package (harvesting)
days_to_first_harvest.quote: The fruits become ready for first picking in about 60-160 days after transplanting depending on the variety.

harvest_span_days.title: Kerala Agricultural University, crop package (harvesting)
harvest_span_days.quote: The crop can be removed after 110 days if the 2nd flush is not desired
harvest_span_days.note: 110 days in the field minus 60 days to first picking = 50 days of picking (one flush).

sun.title: NC State Extension Plant Toolbox
sun.quote: Light: Full sun (6 or more hours of direct sunlight a day)

water_need.title: Kerala Agricultural University, crop package (aftercultivation)
water_need.quote: Irrigate at three or four days interval during summer.
water_need.note: Interpreted: the source recommends regular irrigation every few days in summer; no source uses the low/medium/high scale. Agronomist to confirm.

waterlogging_tolerant.title: Kerala Agricultural University, crop package (climate)
waterlogging_tolerant.quote: Grows best in well-drained silt loam or clay loam soils rich in organic matter.
waterlogging_tolerant.note: Needs well-drained soil, so not waterlogging tolerant (interpreted).

expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.title: Kerala Agricultural University, crop package (harvesting)
expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.quote: Depending on variety and season the average yield of brinjal varies from 20-30 t/ha.

sow_windows.title: ICAR-IIVR cultivation details
sow_windows.note: Nursery sowing months from the source, shifted by the nursery days so the window is the transplant date the planner uses.

source_notes: AI research batch 1 (2026-10-05). Ranges are stored at their lower bound; the source range is in each quote. Sow windows are national ICAR-IIVR months (no Malwa-specific source found yet).
